data.narrative:
Realta Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company that has raised $36M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a broader comp universe of 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private nuclear companies including Fuse Energy, X-Energy, and Oklo, though the narrow peer set within Series A nuclear funding limits cross-company benchmarking.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-round step-ups, using the $36M raised as a proxy floor. This method yields an implied valuation of $72M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable; while 4 same-sector peers exist, insufficient overlap in stage, valuation tier, or financing recency prevented reliable median extraction without introducing sector-wide noise.

The triangulated range supported by applicable methods is $61M (low) to $83M (high), with a median estimate of $72M. This represents a 1.7x to 2.3x multiple on total capital raised. Key uncertainties include technology maturity relative to commercial deployment timelines, regulatory pathway clarity for the fusion subsector, and capital intensity of next-stage development. The analysis relies on a single methodology; additional data on comparable Series A closings or recent Series B outcomes in advanced nuclear would strengthen conviction in this range.
